description: Use only AFTER a checkout or order already exists and the caller has the product-specific tracking details needed to verify its state. Do not use for discovery, offer inspection, or checkout creation; use match_offer, get_live_checkout_offer, or prepare_verified_checkout for those stages. Where supported, the product gateway independently verifies provider payment before reporting paid state.

details.description: Product-specific tracking details returned by checkout, such as purchase key, session ID, order ID, or equivalent verifier input.

public_id.description: Canonical public offer ID for the existing checkout or order.

name: get_verified_order_status
title: After checkout: verify order or payment state
